newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Winterthur planning no big acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur planning no big acquisitions.

text.p: Winterthur Insurance Co said it was not planning any major acquisitions in the near future and investments to build up operations would be limited to a small number of selected markets, such as Eastern Europe and China.

Winterthur said in its interim report that it was concentrating on integrating recently acquired companies, on rationalisation measures and on increasing profits in markets where it is already present.

"After several years in which we have made a number of major acquisitions in order to reinforce our positions in important insurance markets in Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific, we are planning no further major acquisitions for the near-future," Winterthur said in the interim report. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 6321 7340
